comment.body: Thanks for reporting the shortcut and settings-click failures on v0.102.3001.0. The maintainer has already requested a bug report. Please reproduce once, comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward and attach the resulting ZIP to that existing request, naming the exact shortcut and settings target. If the tray or Settings cannot open, run BugReportTool.exe from the PowerToys installation directory. This distinguishes startup failure from an activation/navigation problem; another duplicate request is not necessary.
